scripts.dev: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/domain packages/contracts packages/database apps/api --pretty false && node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n api,web -c blue,green "node apps/api/dist/index.js" "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --configLoader runner"
scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b --pretty false && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config apps/web/vite.config.ts build --configLoader runner
scripts.test: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config packages/domain/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config packages/contracts/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config packages/database/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner
scripts.test:docs: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/Validate-ProductDesign.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/Validate-TechnicalSolution.ps1
